description: This file contains implementation for managing a 'stack' of reference tables in a version control system or similar environment. It includes functions for creating, destroying, reloading, and compacting the stack of tables, as well as handling file IO, locking, range-based compaction, and statistics gathering.

methods.name: int stack_filename(struct reftable_buf * dest,struct reftable_stack * st,const char * name)
methods.description: Constructs the filename path for a table within the stack directory given the table name.

methods.name: int stack_fsync(const struct reftable_write_options * opts,int fd)
methods.description: Fsync wrapper that calls custom fsync if provided, otherwise uses default fsync.

methods.name: ssize_t reftable_write_data(int fd,const void * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes data robustly to a file descriptor, handling partial writes and retries.

methods.name: ssize_t fd_writer_write(void * arg,const void * data,size_t sz)
methods.description: Callback for writing data through a file descriptor writer.

methods.name: int fd_writer_flush(void * arg)
methods.description: Callback for flushing (fsync) a file descriptor writer.

methods.name: int fd_read_lines(int fd,char *** namesp)
methods.description: Reads lines from a file descriptor into an array of string pointers.

methods.name: int read_lines(const char * filename,char *** namesp)
methods.description: Reads lines from a filename, returning a null-terminated array of strings.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator(struct reftable_stack * st,struct reftable_iterator * it)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse reference entries in the stack.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_init_log_iterator(struct reftable_stack * st,struct reftable_iterator * it)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse log entries in the stack.

methods.name: struct:reftable_merged_table * reftable_stack_merged_table(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Returns the merged table associated with the stack.

methods.name: int has_name(char ** names,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a list of names contains a specific name.

methods.name: void reftable_stack_destroy(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Destroys and releases all resources associated with a stack, including tables and file descriptors.

methods.name: struct:reftable_table ** stack_copy_tables(struct reftable_stack * st,size_t cur_len)
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the current tables array.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_reload_once(struct reftable_stack * st,const char ** names,int reuse_open)
methods.description: Reloads the stack's tables once, reusing open tables when possible.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_reload_maybe_reuse(struct reftable_stack * st,int reuse_open)
methods.description: Reloads the stack if it's out of date, with optional reuse of open tables.

methods.name: int reftable_new_stack(struct reftable_stack ** dest,const char * dir,const struct reftable_write_options * _opts)
methods.description: Creates a new ref stack at the specified directory with given options.

methods.name: int stack_uptodate(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Checks whether the in-memory stack matches the on-disk state.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_reload(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Reloads the stack if it is out-of-date.

methods.name: void reftable_addition_close(struct reftable_addition * add)
methods.description: Closes and cleans up an addition operation, releasing resources.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_init_addition(struct reftable_addition * add,struct reftable_stack * st,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Initializes an addition batch with locks and state checks.

methods.name: int stack_try_add(struct reftable_stack * st,int (* write_table)(struct reftable_writer * wr,void * arg),void * arg,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Attempts to add a new table to the stack with concurrency handling.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_add(struct reftable_stack * st,int (* write)(struct reftable_writer * wr,void * arg),void * arg,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Adds a new table to the stack, with reload on conflicts or errors.

methods.name: int format_name(struct reftable_buf * dest,uint64_t min,uint64_t max)
methods.description: Formats a name string with update indices and random component.

methods.name: void reftable_addition_destroy(struct reftable_addition * add)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an addition object.

methods.name: int reftable_addition_commit(struct reftable_addition * add)
methods.description: Commits the current addition by writing to the 'tables.list' and possibly triggering compaction.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_new_addition(struct reftable_addition ** dest,struct reftable_stack * st,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Creates a new addition batch for inserting new tables.

methods.name: int reftable_addition_add(struct reftable_addition * add,int (* write_table)(struct reftable_writer * wr,void * arg),void * arg)
methods.description: Adds a new table to the current addition batch.

methods.name: uint64_t reftable_stack_next_update_index(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Calculates the next update index for the stack.

methods.name: int stack_write_compact(struct reftable_stack * st,struct reftable_writer * wr,size_t first,size_t last,struct reftable_log_expiry_config * config)
methods.description: Writes a compacted range of tables into a writer.

methods.name: int stack_compact_locked(struct reftable_stack * st,size_t first,size_t last,struct reftable_log_expiry_config * config,struct reftable_tmpfile * tab_file_out)
methods.description: Performs the actual compression of a range of tables into a new table file.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_compact_all(struct reftable_stack * st,struct reftable_log_expiry_config * config)
methods.description: Compacts all tables in the stack.

methods.name: int segment_size(struct segment * s)
methods.description: Returns the size of a segment.

methods.name: struct:segment suggest_compaction_segment(uint64_t * sizes,size_t n,uint8_t factor)
methods.description: Suggests a range of tables to compact based on size distributions.

methods.name: int stack_segments_for_compaction(struct reftable_stack * st,struct segment * seg)
methods.description: Identifies segments of tables for potential compaction based on sizes.

methods.name: int update_segment_if_compaction_required(struct reftable_stack * st,struct segment * seg,bool use_geometric,bool * required)
methods.description: Checks if a segment requires compaction based on heuristics.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_compaction_required(struct reftable_stack * st,bool use_heuristics,bool * required)
methods.description: Determines if stack compaction is necessary.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_auto_compact(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Performs automatic stack compaction if needed.

methods.name: struct:reftable_compaction_stats * reftable_stack_compaction_stats(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Returns the current statistics of the stack's compaction process.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_read_ref(struct reftable_stack * st,const char * refname,struct reftable_ref_record * ref)
methods.description: Reads a specific reference record from the stack.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_read_log(struct reftable_stack * st,const char * refname,struct reftable_log_record * log)
methods.description: Reads a specific log record from the stack.
